description: AppHost discovery (used by `aspire ls`, `aspire run`, and other commands) is significantly faster in large repositories. A lightweight XML pre-filter now skips full MSBuild evaluation for projects that clearly are not AppHosts, reducing cold discovery time. The pre-filter also correctly recognizes ancestor Directory.Build.* files, SDK-style imports, and MSBuild walk-up imports as AppHost markers.
name: Faster AppHost discovery in large repositories
